newsitem.title: CANADA: Thunder Bay vessel clearances - April 9.
newsitem.headline: Thunder Bay vessel clearances - April 9.

text.p: Daily vessel loading/clearances at Thunder Bay, Ontario:
April 6 Canadian Leader 26,000 wht Clear 4/7 Stl Ports
April 10 Sarah Spencer 19,000 m/wht Due 4/14 PColbourne
April 11 Mapleglen 21,000 wht Due 4/11 Bay Ports
April 11 Ziemia Chelminska 18,000 wht Due 4/11 Foreign Pt
April 11 H. Lee White 6,000 oats Due 4/11 Huron
April 17 Mangal Desai -- -- Due 4/17 Foreign Pt
April 21 Milin Kamak -- -- Due 4/21 Foreign Pt
April 23 Lake Erie -- -- Due 4/23 Foreign Pt

NOTE: Thunder Bay reopened April 1 when H.M. Griffith cleared. Source: Lake Shippers Clearance Assn. Note wht=wheat, can=canola, m/wht=milling wheat, M=meal, P=pellets, O=oil. Ready=preparing to load. MT=metric tonne. Stl Ports=St Lawrence Ports. Wind=Windsor.
